caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic mug placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The mug is cylindrical with straight, slightly vertical sides and a rounded base. It features a large, curved handle attached to the right side. The surface of the mug is a mottled, earthy brown color with a glossy, reflective finish. There are irregular patches and spots in various shades of brown, tan, and some purplish or violet tinges scattered across the body, giving it a textured and weathered appearance. The rim of the mug is slightly darker, with some areas showing light reflections. The top opening reveals a dark interior with some visible light on the inner surface near the handle. There is no additional object or decoration besides the mug itself.
title: Shaving Mug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
